description: Unsigned transactions to short a stock from the wallet: approve the deposit if needed, then BorroShort.open (borrow the stock, sell it, hold the money plus the deposit). Priced now, with half a percent of slip allowed; simulated from the wallet. The quote's rebate_estimate is what this short puts in the wallet's weekly locker rebate.

amount.description: Stock to short, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

deposit.description: USDG to add to the money held, beyond the sale (optional, default 0), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: open_short
title: Prepare: open a short
